messages:
anya: Quick sync — post-launch priorities for SmartSearch. Foundational bugs vs nice-to-have enhancements. Proposing a 2-week micro-iteration: prioritize P0/P1 fixes + 1 enhancement slot for a customer-facing improvement. Thoughts?

sam: +1 to 2-week micro-iteration. FYI we surfaced 3 regressions after last deploy — logs linked in the incident thread. Can we deprioritize low-usage UI polish for now?

liam: Agree. Suggest we also block one engineer for rollout monitoring and alerts for the duration. Canary window should be 8h not 4h given flaky infra.

jess: Need explicit rollback criteria before we extend canary. Propose: rollback if error rate increases >5% or median latency jump >30ms.

anya: Good call. Rollback criteria: >5% error increase OR >10% CTR drop in the experiment. I'll add to the runbook.

triage-bot: New regression ticket created: #1234 — fuzzy-indexing failing on shard 7 in prod.

nora: Customer A requested a fuzzy-weight controls UI — high business value but not blocking. Suggest we use the 1 enhancement slot for an A/B test of fuzzy weights.

sam: :thumbsup: If we take fuzzy weights, we need an API contract and a short compatibility plan. Who owns?

jess: I can draft the API sketch today. Will ensure backward compatibility.

anya: Owners: jess = API + acceptance criteria, sam = lead on P0 debugging, liam = rollout & monitoring. Quick grooming 10:30 tomorrow — prep: drop 1-sentence acceptance criteria in this thread before EOD.

liam: :eyes: Adding canary dashboard: http://confluence.redwood/smartsearch/canary-dashboard (internal)

sam: Note: the quota bug is only reproducible on Dedicated customers — label as `dedicated-regression` and notify CS.

anya: Good catch, sam. Add label and loop in CS. Decision for enhancement slot: run A/B test (fuzzy vs baseline). If we get >= +3% CTR for target customers we keep it.

jess: Draft acceptance criteria for API: ```
- endpoint: POST /search/config/fuzzy_weights
- accepts: {"weights": {"title": 0-1, "body": 0-1}}
- default behavior: weights omitted -> current scoring preserved
- backward compatibility: existing queries return same top-10 when weights = 1.0
```

sam: LGTM.

nora: I'll consolidate customer asks and push to CS summary doc after EOD.

anya: Thanks all. I'll update the mini-roadmap and send the 10:30 grooming invite. :calendar:
